name: .338 Cal-205gr Power Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this bullet with the .338 Winchester Magnum in mind. We put a 2mm hollow point in this one, that is relatively deep, for about 60% weight retention and to ensure easy expansion. This bullet will load very nicely for feeding from the magazine and have a great velocity for hunting big game out to medium/long range."

sources.note: https://hammerbullets.com/product/338-cal-205gr-power-hammer/: Recommended minimum twist rate is 1-12.75″ | Bullet length is 1.40″ | Bullet weight is 205gr | Recommended use: Big Game Hunting | G1-BC= .394 estimated
